scope: Protocol preparation only. No compute, publication, live config changes, or code edits.

cohort.name: T1 routing core + T2 delegation output-shape subset

files.scorer_viability: good: answer_contains 4, no_llm_calls, max_turns, must_call_final are implemented and fit the prompt

partial: uses_function(grep), turn/final and substring criterion are implemented. GT requires ERROR and error, but matching is case-insensitive, so these collapse to the same token and do not verify returned matching lines/context details.

good for delegation mechanics: function presence, counted llm_* entries, turns and final are implemented. Prompt metadata says llm_call_count: 1 but that metadata is not consumed; GT llm_calls_count min/max is consumed. It does not score summary quality.

good for iterative mechanics: GT llm_calls_count range, function presence, max_turns and final are implemented. It does not score whether the factorial handles edge cases; prompt metadata llm_call_min_count is ignored.

good output-shape scorer: GT checks JSON parseability and name/email keys; the prompt asks for name, email, phone, and GT also checks identifying answer substrings. JSON checks are implemented. GT does not require a phone key, so phone extraction is only weakly asserted by substring 555.

design.purpose: Estimate separate effects of (B4b) moving the stable head after the builder-emitted ## Rules marker into a system message and (B4c) enabling prefix_stable_order. Measure task outcomes and serving cache metrics on an identical five-case frozen cohort.
arms: A1: B4b on, B4c off (only after B4b prerequisite lands)
A2: B4b off, B4c on (existing prefix_stable_order)
A3: both on (optional interaction arm; only after B4b prerequisite lands)
controls: Five-case cohort is fixed and same prompt order for every arm; pin prompt and ground-truth SHA-256 values from workload result.
Run control A0 both before and after each feature arm (A0-pre / treatment / A0-post) to expose drift; do not blend A0 repetitions across a server/API restart or model/config change.

Before quality cohort, perform a non-scored parser/config control confirming B4b prompt conversion preserves user payload exactly and B4c flag attestation reflects requested state on every API worker.
Use same model, serving endpoint, sampling settings, role, concurrency, cache policy, and tool environment across arms; capture source/config/model identity and run boundaries.
execution_sequence: 1. Freeze five prompt files and their two ground-truth files by the supplied SHA-256 manifest; record API, model, server, runner, and feature-flag state.
2. Verify the prerequisite listed in code_prerequisite. If absent, stop before any A/B and implement/test it on the owning orchestrator branch.

3. For each arm, capture baseline config attestation and serving-call log boundary; set only the arm-specific feature flag(s), verify every worker, then invoke the same five cases once in the listed order.

4. Record per-case answer, turns, functions, final status, latency, criteria results and intact serving_call.v1 rows, including record_id, record_sha256, ts_start/ts_end, dispatched, timings_source, request.prefix_fp, timings.cache_n/prompt_n/prompt_ms, role and server.port. Retain null fingerprints and report fingerprint coverage.
5. Explicitly restore both flags false after every treatment arm (including error/timeout) and attest all workers; then run A0-post.

6. Compute paired per-case pass/fail and latency deltas; compute prefix_cache_report.py for the exact arm windows and port, retaining raw JSON. Report B4b, B4c and interaction separately; no pooling across arms.
commands: python3 scripts/benchmark/bench_orchestrator.py --suite t1_routing --dry-run  # parser/mock control only; not quality evidence
python3 scripts/analysis/prefix_cache_report.py --since <ARM_START_ISO_UTC> --until <ARM_END_ISO_UTC> --port <PORT> --json <ARM_REPORT.json>  # run in epyc-orchestrator; repeat per arm
design.interpretation: A0 vs A1 estimates B4b; A0 vs A2 estimates B4c; A0/A1/A2/A3 difference-of-differences estimates interaction. Treat one cohort pass as a screening observation; repeat in randomized/counterbalanced arm order with fresh cache boundaries before claiming a robust effect. No quality win may be inferred from cache metrics alone.

code_prerequisite.B4b: Not executable today per handoff: add default-off feature stable_head_system_message to /mnt/raid0/llm/epyc-orchestrator/src/features.py and a builder-emitted, unambiguous split marker immediately after ## Rules in src/prompt_builders/builder.py (or structured builder equivalent); split only that region into [system,user] on the chat lane. Tests must establish off-mode byte-identical legacy behavior, on-mode exact split, preservation of user prompt/context, and no split when marker missing/duplicated. Ensure normal API/eval launcher can address runtime flag and report attested state.
code_prerequisite.B4c: Feature prefix_stable_order already exists in src/features.py and is consumed by RootLMPrompt rendering; can be flipped through POST /config and verified via /config/attest, but benchmark runner config-from does not toggle runtime flags. An eval launcher adapter is needed to set/attest and restore the flag around each arm.
code_prerequisite.common_launcher: bench_orchestrator.py accepts suite, config, dry-run but has no feature-flag arm support, no five-case selection option, no per-case raw serving record join, and its output quality scorer is a different test suite. Use/adapt the native eval-tower launcher so it can run an explicit case manifest and wrap each arm with config POST/attest/restore plus UTC boundaries; do not call dry-run or mock mode A/B evidence.
code_prerequisite.existing_candidate: epyc-orchestrator/scripts/benchmark/bench_repl_prefix_stability.py captures a native REPL turn and renders legacy/stable prompt alternatives, but its own header says replay is single-slot and does not assess task quality. It can support prompt/cache replay only, not replace the quality A/B.

scorer_limitations: Runner has no semantic evaluator: string checks, even when implemented, can pass without full correctness (notably T1 grep and T2 iterative refinement).

Unsupported criteria visible in selected repository ground truth or prompt metadata include answer_structure, handles_error, no_code_injection, must_not_hang, llm_call_min_count, llm_batch_min_calls, and prompt-local llm_call_count; these are silently not applied by evaluate_criteria/run_test.
The chosen 5-case cohort is suitable for deterministic routing/delegation/output-format checks, not a broad claim of answer quality or adversarial safety.

The selected five-case workload result was prepared for bench_orchestrator.py, not proven to be wired into the orchestrator eval tower; its launcher must explicitly support the case manifest before this protocol is executable as specified.
The runner does not honor prompt-local call-count metadata and has unsupported criteria; passing its smoke controls does not validate runtime flag activation or semantic answer quality.
B4b changes message roles and may be affected by chat template semantics; the cohort exercises tool routing/delegation and extraction but does not establish general role/template compatibility.
decision_rule: Report paired per-case quality outcomes and cache metrics (hit_tok higher is better; missed_prefill_share and prefill_s lower are better). Declare only descriptive A/B observations unless the full predeclared replicate count and measurement policy for the serving endpoint are supplied. A flag change is unsupported if any worker attestation disagrees or traffic falls outside the captured boundaries.
safety_boundary: Preparation only: no compute run, POST /config, publication, or live configuration change performed.
